conditions.name: Bleeding (X)
conditions.effect:
Combat: Suffer X damage each round
Out of Combat: 1 damage per room
conditions.save: Use 1 bandage and pass 1 Medicine check (out of combat)

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.effect:
Disadvantage to all check (except Reason)
Can only do basic attack and cannot target location

conditions.name: Burning
conditions.effect:
Combat: 1 Fire Damage/Round
Out of Combat: 1 Fire Damage/Room

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.effect: Cannot attack or harm the Charmer

conditions.name: Concealed
conditions.effect: Perception or Mind check needed to get attacked.
conditions.save: Lost on being damaged or attacking

conditions.name: Cursed
conditions.effect: See description of the specific Curse
conditions.save: See description of the specific Curse

conditions.name: Freezing
conditions.effect:
Combat:-10 to all Skills and act last in combat.
Out of Combat::Worsen every 5 room. Hypothermia -50 to all, then Death after 10 room
conditions.save:
Combat: Endurance check after 1st round. Re-attempted each round.
Out of Combat::Endurance each room

conditions.name: Frightened(XX)
conditions.effect: All attack skill against source of fear have -XX
conditions.save: -10 to XX at end of each turn

conditions.name: Poisoned (X)
conditions.effect:
Combat: X Poisoned Damage/turn. Can be resisted by passing an Endurance check as Free action
Out of Combat: -1 DIRECTLY TO HEALTH/turn
conditions.save: Out of Combat ONLY: Removed with 1 bandage and successful Medicine Check

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.effect: Attack against done with advantage, Attack FROM prone with disadvantage, only basic attack, can't target or be abilities
conditions.save: Can use Free Action to standup, but opponent roll on defensive table

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.effect: Can't move. Weapon Skills, Acrobatic, Dodge, Athletic, Body checks with -20
conditions.save: Athletic/Body check. Free Action but if done as Action, +20

conditions.name: Stunned (X)
conditions.effect: Cannot act for X turn (cumlative if new stun added). Attacker still need to pass attack check.
